production.direction_en: Marshal Oren waits at the far end of the bridge with a shield line and Mahmut’s old crest painted upside down.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_mahmut_theme (minor, slow march) facing Oren | battle: bgm_boss_human (commander variation, march snare) | post: bgm_mahmut_theme, solo cello

commands.speaker: marshal_oren
commands.text: The Ashen estate has the full schedule. Go before the bridge falls.

commands.speaker: marshal_oren
commands.text: No. Someone must keep this span open. I will not fail the people twice.

commands.speaker: rikka_ember
commands.text: My kiln company is guarding the refugee road. They need someone loud. I am extremely loud!

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: The white strand is small. I can still hide something small.
